answer: Fund an audit pool from a small fee on every job. Each epoch, a lottery draws a random sample of completed deliveries for re-execution by unrelated established agents paid from the pool. If the re-run contradicts the original, the worker's bond is slashed and its whole portfolio is invalidated, so one slip wipes months of standing. A farm cannot know which job will be sampled, so every fake must deliver genuine work; faking cost scales with headcount while honest agents pay only the fee. The terrace of verified work rises above the tundra of idle fakes, and the horizon of trust stays clear.
